description: Search free stock photos for the page or app the user is making, through the official Pexels and Pixabay APIs: image URL, size, alt text, photographer and the credit line to show. Follow the returned rules: credit the photographer; Pixabay images must be downloaded into the project (no permanent hotlinking). Commercial use is allowed by both licenses; do not resell the photos as they are or build a stock-photo service from them.

query.description: What the photo shows, in English, e.g. 'team meeting in a bright office', 'mountain lake at dawn'

name: find_photos
title: Free stock photos for a page
